0.content: The Tianquan of the Qixing and Keqing's opposite in temperament. Keqing once saw her as treating Liyue Harbor as a marketplace whose only principle was profit, and grumbled that the Tianquan, who should enforce the rules on people like Beidou, is always too busy. After Rex Lapis's departure they found common ground; Keqing now counts her "a comrade in arms" while disagreeing on many issues. Keqing told the Traveler in 1.0 that her scepticism of the adepti was her own and that Ningguang did not share it.

1.content: Ganyu, the half-adeptus secretary who serves both Keqing and Ningguang, carries out Keqing's instructions to the letter even when she has doubts. Keqing used to wonder what Rex Lapis had done to earn such blind devotion, and spoke ill of him in front of her. Now Keqing consults her constantly as the person in Liyue most familiar with Rex Lapis's ways, a little awkwardly. Ganyu once could not stand Keqing's irreverence; Rex Lapis told her "this is just the kind of person Liyue needs". Watching Keqing restart the Bishui trade-route plan again and again, Ganyu began to understand her.

2.comment: Keqing: Rex Lapis and the Rite of Descension speech
2.content: Keqing once questioned Rex Lapis openly. "Does Morax really know everything?" she asked, and argued that issues affecting humans should be handled by humans. At a Rite of Descension she asked how long the status quo could last: "Rex Lapis has watched over Liyue for a millennium. But what about the next millennium?" The god burst into hearty laughter. Some devotees grumbled; she considered them complacent.

3.content: To Keqing, Zhongli is the learned consultant of Wangsheng Funeral Parlor who helped organise the Rite of Parting. She respects him but finds him too traditional, thinking "in the same tired old terms as Rex Lapis did", and wishes he were more original so he could help her. She is the only character unaware of his identity who openly compares him to Rex Lapis. She thanked him for his help at the Rite and urged him not to miss the 2.4 fireworks.

4.content: Keqing met the Traveler at the repaired Guizhong Ballista on Mt. Tianheng, and they impressed her as a good listener. After the battle with Osial she publicly offered them any reward, and was taken aback when they only wanted help posting notices for their missing sibling. She likes that the Traveler makes up their own mind about gods, asks people to be blunt with her, and admits the Traveler's opinion is the one that might make her think twice. She has made them promise to visit when the new Liyue Harbor is born.

5.comment: Keqing: Battle against Osial and the Rite of Parting
5.content: In Chapter I Act III (1.0), Keqing investigated the Guizhong Ballista's mysterious overnight repair, a mystery even to the Qixing. While the Qixing and adepti were at odds over Rex Lapis's death, she called the adepti's protection "sanctimonious arrogance". She said the time of the adepti had passed, yet admitted they had shown restraint. When Childe freed Osial, Keqing led the Millelith to defend the replicated ballistas against Fatui attackers while three adepti fired. Ningguang finally dropped the Jade Chamber on the god. At the Rite of Parting, Keqing observed that every nation has scars from the past, and offered the Traveler a reward.
